interests.title: Research Interests
content: My research focuses on computer science education at the K-12 level.
I am interested in how to incorporate critical, place-based pedagogies into computer science through the creation of personally relevant artifacts that can affect change.

content.title: CYI: Creating Young Innovators
description: Creating Young Innovators is a research practice partnership between Colorado School of Mines, University of Colorado Boulder, and Aurora Public Schools.
The goal is to co-design new computer science units in which students use the micro:bit to investigate their own environment, aligned with the CSTA K–12 Computer Science Standards.
